$comment: Policy for bin/cleanup-environments.mjs (.github/workflows/environments.yml). An environment NOT listed here is deleted outright, along with its deployments, unless it looks like a real protected gate (required reviewers or secrets), in which case it's left alone and reported. See docs/environment-janitor.md and CLAUDE.md's 'Environment cleanup' architecture note for this pipeline. The other monte3l repositories run these same scripts through the org workflow template (monte3l/.github, workflow-templates/environments.yml), pinned to a commit of this repo, and read their own copy of this file format.
